categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily operates in the textile industry, focusing on fabric weaving, dyeing and finishing, and the wholesale and retail of textiles and related products. It also engages in the wholesale of dyes, pigments, and industrial auxiliaries, as well as international trade. The main products include jacquard fabrics for home furnishings, apparel fabrics, outdoor functional fabrics, and textile dyes and auxiliaries.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company employs advanced textile technologies such as computer-aided design and digital jacquard weaving, enabling rapid market response and customization. It focuses on developing high-value functional textiles with properties like fire resistance, UV protection, antibacterial, and deodorizing effects. The dyeing and finishing processes emphasize environmental compliance and sustainable practices, integrating eco-friendly dyeing methods.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include apparel and home furnishing manufacturers, with significant sales to international brands such as Nike, Under Armour, and Adidas. The company serves markets in Taiwan, the Americas, and Asia, including emerging markets like Vietnam, Bangladesh, and Cambodia. The end markets focus on functional textiles for sportswear, fashion, and health care sectors.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly in Taiwan with expanding operations and investments in Southeast Asia, particularly Vietnam, to leverage lower labor costs and proximity to markets. It exports products to the Americas and other Asian countries, actively participating in international textile exhibitions to align with global trends.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates primarily in the midstream segment of the textile supply chain, specializing in weaving, dyeing, and finishing of fabrics. It sources raw materials such as fibers and dyes from upstream suppliers and supplies finished fabrics to downstream apparel and home textile manufacturers.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include expanding the dye and auxiliary chemicals business, enhancing product differentiation through functional textiles, and developing eco-friendly and high-value-added products. R&D efforts focus on improving design capabilities, collaborating with academia for innovative smart textiles, and developing products with fire retardant, UV protection, antibacterial, and deodorizing functions. The company plans to invest in production facilities in Vietnam to support long-term competitiveness.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated mainly through product sales of textile fabrics, dyes, and industrial auxiliaries. The company also engages in international trade and wholesale activities. Revenue growth is driven by expanding sales channels, especially in functional textile dyes and auxiliaries, and by entering new geographic markets.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company competes in a highly competitive textile industry with pressures from low-cost producers in emerging countries like China and India. It differentiates itself by focusing on technology-intensive, small-batch, diversified, and high-quality functional textiles. Its niche positioning and strong customer relationships with major international brands support stable growth despite intense competition.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: The company has shown significant growth in recent years, with 2022 consolidated revenue reaching approximately NT$1.2 billion, a 149.81% increase from the previous year, and net profit of NT$307 million. Financial ratios indicate improved profitability and asset utilization, with ROA and ROE rising substantially. The company has strengthened its financial structure through private placements and capital increases, supporting ongoing expansion and R&D investments.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes customized, high-value functional textiles that meet evolving market demands for performance and environmental compliance. Its rapid design-to-production capabilities, integration of advanced textile technologies, and focus on eco-friendly and smart textile solutions provide competitive differentiation. The company also leverages strong customer intimacy and supply chain management to deliver quality and innovation.
